summary_en: TOMONY Holdings approved acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (0.51% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥1.1 billion via market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2024 to January 29, 2025, to support capital efficiency and flexible capital allocation toward a payout ratio target of 35% or higher by fiscal 2028.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2024, TOMONY Holdings' board of directors approved the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares of the company for a maximum total amount of ¥1.1 billion. The shares will be purchased on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2024 through January 29, 2025, representing up to 0.51% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). As of October 31, 2024, the company held 337,532 treasury shares against 193,195,479 shares outstanding.

The company intends to use the acquired shares to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation. The buyback will also provide shares for exercise of previously granted share acquisition rights and for delivery under restricted share unit compensation programs. The company targets a payout ratio of 35% or higher and a total return ratio of 40% or higher by fiscal 2028, to be achieved through stable and sustainable dividend growth combined with opportunistic share repurchases. Combined with an interim dividend and an upward revision to the full-year dividend announced the same day, the total return ratio for fiscal 2024 is expected to reach approximately 38.5%.
